theme.title: Theme
theme.description: System follows your operating system. Dark is the default design; light is for bright rooms and printing.

catalog.description: Built into the app: {apps} apps, {devices} device models, {cpus} CPUs. Works offline.
catalog.updates: Weekly catalog updates, source status and rollback arrive with version 1.0.

units.description: Currency, energy price and default capacity thresholds for new projects arrive with version 1.0. Until then, set thresholds and overcommit per project in Project settings.

storage.unknown: This browser does not report storage usage.
storage.persisted: Granted. The browser keeps your projects even when disk space runs low.
storage.notPersisted: Not granted. The browser may clear your projects when disk space runs low — export backups regularly.
storage.backupsDescription: {count, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}} · last export: {last}. A JSON export is a complete backup of a project.
storage.deleteDescription: Delete all projects and settings from this browser. This cannot be undone.
storage.confirmDescription: {count, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}} and all settings will be removed from this browser. Export what you want to keep first.

overview.description: Server Planner is a free, open-source planner for home labs: devices, racks and rooms, networks and firewalls, VMs, containers and apps, with capacity checks and traffic simulation. It runs entirely in your browser.
overview.privacyValue: No accounts, no telemetry, no cookies. Projects stay in this browser unless you export them.

recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.description: selfh.st — a living directory of self-hosted apps. Not used as a data source.

sources.description: Catalog {version}. The catalog as a whole is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. In this version it consists of the curated layer maintained in the repository; automatic weekly imports from the other sources arrive with version 1.0.

curated.name: Curated layer (this project)
curated.usedFor: Apps, traffic patterns and flows, device models, CPUs, OS

community-scripts.name: Proxmox VE Community Scripts
community-scripts.usedFor: Default CPU / RAM / disk for apps
